definitions: To begin to think seriously and creatively about a problem or task.
To concentrate and use one's intelligence to solve something.
examples: We need to put our thinking caps on to figure out this puzzle.
Okay team, let's put our thinking caps on and brainstorm some solutions.
I'll put my thinking cap on and see if I can come up with an idea.
lemma: to put your thinking cap on
source: to put your thinking cap on
